title: How to Explain TMS
subtitle: A guest appearance on the Carlat Psychiatry Podcast
body_html:
One of the more delightful things about the work that I get to do, as a Psychiatrist at Radial, is explaining a better future for a psychiatric patient with novel treatments. I've gotten to know the gracious Chris Aiken, M.D. over the last several years now, along with his fabulous cohost Kellie Newsome, NP, at the Carlat Psychiatry Podcast. I was a guest this past week, discussing transcranial magnetic stimulation, which is one of my reliably favorite talks to have! Additional resources on this topic can be found over on the Radial blog, such as “What is TMS Therapy?”
